source.title: [Bounty #743] Validate /api/messages payload before persistence
source.body:
## Problem

POST /api/messages forwards req.body directly to sendMessage without schema validation. Any JSON object is accepted, including missing senderId/receiverId, empty content, oversized content, and prototype pollution fields. The in-memory message store then persists malformed message entities, corrupting conversation threads and breaking client chat interfaces.

## Requested fix

Add a strict Zod schema for message creation and validate the request in messageController before persistence. Require valid senderId and receiverId strings, require non-empty content up to 5,000 characters, allow optional conversationId, and reject malformed payloads with a 400 Bad Request error envelope. Add focused route/service tests for valid payload, missing fields, empty/oversized content, and unknown property rejection.

This issue is limited only to the creator of this issue. This means that only the issue author can attempt to solve this issue. If you would like to work on it, please create another issue with the same contents and refer to issue #743 for more information.

This issue is created under the Low Handing Fruit Automation bounty. I will submit a PR that references this issue and issue #743.

/bounty $700
